lines.cap: Every thesis starts the same way: with a pile of PDFs.
Which papers actually support your research gap?
Reading them all takes time, | and you still end up with citations you can't trace.
This is CiteWise: an AI-powered research assistant | that takes you from research gap to drafted introduction, | in one connected flow.
Step one: Data Import.
One click brings in your research title, rationale, and gaps | from your CATalyst workspace.
Then you upload your related literature as PDFs.
Step two: AI Assessment.
Each paper is scored against your research gap | on four weighted criteria: | gap alignment, methodology, theory, and citation quality.
Every score comes with word-for-word evidence, | verified to the exact page, so you can check it yourself.
You stay in control: approve what fits, leave out what doesn't.
Step three: Generate Introduction.
CiteWise drafts your introduction from only the sources you approved, | with in-text citations and a reference list.
Paraphrase it, keep a version history, and export to PDF or Word.
On real research papers, text extraction finished in under half a second, | and a full AI assessment averaged about 24 seconds, | against a 30-second target.
Change the weights, and scores update with no extra AI call.
Less time sorting papers.
More time doing research.
Every claim traceable to its source.
CiteWise: discover research gaps, and draft with confidence.
